description: Agent Wallet Spend Report: what has this wallet been paying for? Outgoing USDC payments on Base over the last N days (max 14), grouped by payee, each payee named with the x402 services that pay out to it (from the ~35k-endpoint x402 index), totals, daily rate, micropayment count, share going to known x402 sellers. Public chain data. By OMENZ. (MCP calls run in AYNE, the free playzone; production: GET https://www.omenz.org/api/tollbooth/v1/wallet/spend, $0.005 via x402.)
